digest.component_or_area: CLI bridge command group and nested verb dispatch
propositions: bridge preview and bridge sync subcommands must be functional with preview performing no Jira or ticket-store mutation and sync mutating persisted state
legacy top-level commands (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, rebar doctor) must remain fully functional and not broken by the bridge noun introduction
nested bridge subcommand dispatch must not fall through to or collide with top-level command names
Mode, MODE_CAPS, and gated_mode round-trip behavior must survive unchanged to maintain MCP surface and phase-gate compatibility
no unimplemented placeholder verb shall be advertised in user guide, CLI reference, or release notes until its handler and consumer migrations land
all in-repo consumers and workflows must continue working at the story boundary without requiring simultaneous changes
